new_findings.rule: Bytes(28, x >> 32) followed by Bytes(4, uint32(x)) is x for any 256-bit x: fold it. A masked store prints only the bytes it changes; bytes it writes back unchanged are not a write.

improvements: 248 calls are now named with decoded arguments (P2 255 -> 3: debtOf, repay, getReserveData, getAssetPrice, approve, transfer, permit2 transferFrom...). All 53 'revert with memory' now show custom errors (0x302a624a, 0x111c379d, 0x2755faea, 0x85e98beb, SafeERC20FailedOperation 0x5274afe7, 0x9773bb71 with two bytes args and exact padding). 7 returns and 8 event payloads are decoded (T_Deposit(_amount), T_Borrow(amount, receiver), T_Skim(balance - old total), Initialized(1)). P1 30 -> 0, P6 4 -> 0 (0x0c00c962). Many dead memory writes are gone (8525 -> 7520 lines), and two if/else-with-revert blocks became early reverts.
notes: Diff 9098 lines (functions reordered), reviewed by structure: per-function diffs plus a skeleton comparison (control flow, calls, storage/transient writes, events, reverts, returns) of the 16 changed functions, with variable renumbering and mem[_N] -> ext_call.return_data[0] normalized away. Skeletons match one for one, except 2 if/else-with-revert merged into early reverts (redeemUnderlying, repay) and one early revert turned into 'if _1291: ... else: revert' (unknown0e308a5e 7457, P10-like, cosmetic). Checked by hand: unknownfc472b4f in full; rebalance stor1 = _155 - _5 (repay's return value, as before); initialize forceApprove (first approve's target now printed as ext_call.return_data[0], no call lost); unknown0e308a5e: the overflow check of div * price is now explicit before the * stor62 check (it was inside SafeMath.mul before), same order, all Panic(17); liquidate and unknown4b3d1223: reordered sums and products have the same terms; every ext_call.return_data[0] substituted for mem[_N] has no call in between. Return-data reads now sometimes precede the success check (_3 = ext_call.return_data[0]), harmless. The only while (claimRewards) is unchanged.
summary: No semantic regression: 248 calls named, all reverts/events decoded, P1/P6 gone, 1000 lines shorter. Two low readability regressions (long ceil32 offset sums; the reserve id re-read as a memory slice) and one new low finding (address arguments split into Bytes(28)/Bytes(4)).
